description: Trunk Roads - Scotland is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Scottish Government SpatialData.gov.scot. This line dataset contains the geometry and some basic attribution (like descriptor and Unique Street Reference Number) for every 'trunk' (or private company-maintained) road in Scotland. It has been taken directly from the national street gazetteer (part of the One Scotland Gazetteer). Coverage: Scottish Government SpatialData.gov.scot. The portal files it under the publisher Scottish Government SpatialData.gov.scot. Its tags are Transport networks. The portal shows 2025-11-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
